WITH transaction_with_customer AS (
  SELECT 
    ft.transaction_amount,
    c.state_county_province
  FROM Financial_Transactions ft
  INNER JOIN Accounts a ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
  INNER JOIN Customers c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE ft.transaction_amount IS NOT NULL
),
state_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    state_county_province,
    SUM(transaction_amount) as state_total
  FROM transaction_with_customer
  GROUP BY state_county_province
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(state_total) as grand_total,
    COUNT(*) as num_states
  FROM state_totals
),
state_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    st.state_total,
    st.state_total / s.grand_total as share,
    1.0 / s.num_states as avg_share
  FROM state_totals st
  CROSS JOIN stats s
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT 
    state_total,
    share,
    avg_share
  FROM state_shares
  WHERE share > avg_share
)
SELECT 
  SUM(state_total) as combined_transaction_total,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(share - avg_share) as average_excess_amount
FROM above_average
